title: Hostile enemy encounter census (ai_* attribution)
summary: One Story session. An idle control, then 30 s in sight of the first HOSTILE enemies. The census (indirect call targets) of the encounter is ranked against the idle control and the ai_* / char_class functions are attributed by tools.ai_attribution (T1741). Session folder tmp/owner-profiles/enemy-encounter-STAMP. Where the first hostile NPCs are is INFERRED, see docs/t-ai-enemy-encounter.md.
duration: about 15 minutes after the game is up, plus the time to reach the enemies
prerequisites: Game HDD tmp/hdds/profile-hdd (your Story profile). The script builds the private host first, which takes a few minutes.
A Story save that can reach the first hostile enemies past the rebel base. The first minutes are friendly scripted rebels (T1225), do not stop there.

steps.text: Press Enter at 'Enter = start the game'. When the window opens drive to Story yourself and play to the first enemies that SHOOT AT YOU. Nothing is measured until you continue at a phase prompt.

note_at_end: Which level/area and how long into the level you met the first hostile enemy, and what they looked like.
Whether they shot at you, chased you, called others, died (and how many shots).
If the game stopped: the 'unimplemented instruction at ...' or STOP line.
stop: Enter in this terminal starts and again ends a phase. s skips, q finishes. Close the window only after the last phase.
send_back: Tell Claude the session finished: folder tmp/owner-profiles/enemy-encounter-STAMP (the ai attribution table is printed at the end).

ingame-idle.title: Idle control next to the enemies
ingame-idle.go_to: The spot where the hostile enemies are about to see you, but they have NOT noticed you yet (or stand behind cover)
ingame-idle.do: Stand still. Do not press any button and do not move the stick.

ingame-enemy-encounter.title: Fight the hostile enemies
ingame-enemy-encounter.go_to: Within sight of the first hostile enemies
ingame-enemy-encounter.do: Let them see you, take cover, shoot them, let them chase and shoot at you. Keep the fight going for the whole window.
ingame-enemy-encounter.note: the area, the number of enemies, what they did
